model: Ridge linear probability model fitted to household outcomes; features standardized using training households only; predictions clipped to [0,1].
selection_metric: Validation-split household Brier score; ties choose the smaller alpha.
interval_scope: Held-out treatment-effect intervals condition on the frozen training weights and validation-selected alpha; they do not include training/tuning weight uncertainty.
decision: Exploratory educational learned proxy only. Report individual prediction separately from held-out treatment-effect agreement. Never grant surrogate approval from this analysis.
